changelog:
- Fokk AI Credibility Tiers: Replaced conflicting confidence scores and buzzwords with a unified score formula, honest tiered verdicts (Officially confirmed, Credibly reported, Single-source, Unconfirmed), and visible scoring rationale.
- Scraper Junk Purge: Filtered engagement metrics, follower counts, handles, and reply threads on X/Twitter and social platforms to strictly isolate focal editorial content.
- Page Authenticity and Distribution Channel: Re-labeled Layer 1 to clearly distinguish between aggregator host platforms (such as x.com) and original reporting newsrooms (such as Sky Sports).
- Ask AI Direct Answers: Reframed AI answers to address reality directly in the lead sentence, highlighting what each newsroom contributes without artificial certainty.
- Clean Source Attribution and Entity Decoding: Resolved raw HTML entity artifacts across search providers, ensuring clean publisher attribution.
- Seamless Back Navigation: Tapping back from corroborating evidence tabs now gracefully closes the child tab and returns to the parent page.
- Instant Re-opening and Fokk AI History: Added instant in-memory analysis caching and persistent Fokk AI verification history with search, inspect, and item deletion support.
